This plot is far from the big markets where fertilizer is cheap, and I never went to school so I have not learned those new methods. The soil here near the coast is sandy and tired, so I put kraal manure when I can get it from the neighbor's cattle. I keep my own seeds from last harvest like my father did, and I weed by hand with my wife and children. Sometimes during clearing I pay a few young men to help me, because 1.35 hectares is too much for one old man with a jembe.
